text: ITEM 1 | About 30 oval, smooth-skinned tan-to-brown pieces, each roughly 2 to 2.5 cm long and 1.2 cm wide, with pointed ends and a faint longitudinal ridge. They are dry, matte, and firm, with no visible oil or sheen. Pieces are piled loosely in a single layer that partly stacks in the centre, filling about 60% of a white, round, roughly 15 cm bowl. No cooking marks or sauce are visible. | 35
